input.title: Tick the weekly rollup schedule more than once an hour
input.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

startRollupSchedule only ticks at the top of each UTC hour, so isRollupDue (which fires when the user's local hour first reads 8) only catches time zones whose UTC offset is a whole number of hours. For offsets of 30 or 45 minutes (Asia/Kolkata, America/St_Johns, Asia/Kathmandu), the local hour doesn't turn to 8 until partway into a UTC hour, and the next tick lands 15-45 minutes later than the intended 08:00 local. Tick every 15 minutes instead of every hour (and keep isRollupDue's own guard against double-sending) so these offsets are caught at the right local minute too.

label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The rollup scheduler only ticks at the top of each UTC hour (startRollupSchedule), and isRollupDue fires as soon as a user's local hour reads 8. That works for whole-hour UTC offsets, but Asia/Kolkata (+5:30), America/St_Johns (-3:30) and Asia/Kathmandu (+5:45) don't cross into local hour 8 until partway through a UTC hour, so the next hourly tick lands 30, 30 and 45 minutes late respectively — exactly what's reported. Ticking every 15 minutes instead of every hour would catch these offsets at the right local minute.

text: Triaged issue-4602 as a **bug** in `src/notifications/rollup.ts`: the weekly-rollup scheduler ticks only once per UTC hour, so users whose timezone offset isn't a whole number of hours (Asia/Kolkata +5:30, America/St_Johns -3:30, Asia/Kathmandu +5:45) get their 08:00 local notification 30–45 minutes late. Opened pr-25 proposing a 15-minute tick interval, and posted the triage comment.
